description: List the tags used in the organization, most-used first, each with monitor_count and heartbeat_count, as items. Call it before tagging anything so you reuse an existing name instead of inventing a near-duplicate. Not a filter: to find the monitors or heartbeats carrying a tag, pass tag to list_monitors or list_heartbeats. Returns every tag at once, not a page.

kind.description: monitor or heartbeat lists only the tags that kind of item uses; all (the default) lists both. Both counts are reported either way.

name: list_tags
title: List tags
